postings.title: AI Platform Architect
postings.description:
About us

Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. 

It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry. 

As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone. 

Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore enjoys a culture of continuous learning and constant innovation. 

Job Summary 

We are seeking for a visionary AI Platform Architect to design and oversee the comprehensive infrastructure stack that powers our most demanding distributed AI workloads. Moving beyond individual hardware components, this role acts as the unifying technical authority across hardware, software, compute, network, and storage. You will be responsible for architecting a cohesive, AI rack scale platform optimized for

trillion-parameter LLM training and high-throughput inference. By orchestrating everything from advanced clustering and distributed training frameworks down to the physical layer—spanning PCIe Gen 5/6 pathways, NVMe storage topologies, and RDMA fabrics—you will ensure our AI research and deployment teams have a flawless, frictionless, and extraordinarily powerful platform at their disposal.

Responsibilities and Duties

- End-to-End Platform Architecture: Define the holistic architecture for highly clustered AI environments, ensuring zero-bottleneck data flow between parallel storage systems, AI compute nodes, and ultra-high-bandwidth network fabrics.

- Workload Orchestration: Influence the strategy for AI workload scheduling and orchestration, utilizing tools like Kubernetes or Slurm to manage distributed training jobs, model check-pointing, and inference serving at massive scale.

- Full-Stack Optimization: Profile and eliminate system-level bottlenecks across the entire AI pipeline, tuning everything from deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, DeepSpeed, etc.) down to OS-level NUMA pinning and I/O scheduling.

- Hardware-Software Co-design: Work closely with software, firmware, and OS engineering to influence platform design, ensuring the software stack fully exploits underlying hardware capabilities, including complex ARM mesh interconnects (RNI, HNF, SNF) and advanced merchant silicon features.

- Silicon Influencing Strategy: Drive the 3-to-5-year technical vision for the AI platform. Collaborate closely with subject matter experts in processor, memory, storage, GPU, thermal, mechanical, BIOS, and Manageability disciplines to define requirements specifications to communicate and present to internal and external silicon teams to influence features, optimized board routing guidelines, power and thermal targets, and the correct feeds and speeds for a competitive AI platform. This will require a deep knowledge of the AI industry and significant market competitive analysis including TCO (OPEX / CAPEX) analysis of new technologies.

Candidate Profile 

Essential:

- Experience: Demonstrated ability in systems engineering, cloud architecture, or HPC, hardware engineering with at least 4+ years functioning as a Lead or Principal Architect for large-scale AI or machine learning platforms.

- Distributed AI Frameworks: Deep practical knowledge of how large models are trained and deployed, including data/tensor/pipeline parallelism and the infrastructure requirements of modern LLM architectures.

- Systems Interconnects: Authoritative understanding of system-level bottlenecks and data pathways, including deep familiarity with PCIe Gen 5/6, NVMe namespaces, and RDMA (RoCEv2/InfiniBand) integration.

- Orchestration & Containerization: Experience with container orchestration platforms and infrastructure-as-code (IaC) tailored for GPU-heavy bare-metal and cloud environments.

- Cross-Domain Leadership: Exceptional ability to bridge the gap between AI researchers/data scientists and low-level hardware/CPU/memory/storage/GPU/network engineers, translating model requirements into strict infrastructure specifications. Ability to generate Platform engineering requirement specifications that can be used to guide and influence future silicon designs.

Desirable

- Rack scale GPU AI Platforms experience: Hands on experience with rack-as-a-system

- AI platforms that integrate all the latest networking, cooling, and GPU technologies currently present in the market.

- Software / Scripting experience: Working knowledge of scripting language such as Python/JSON to characterize workloads on bare metal AI compute systems to expose issues with current Neural engine silicon solutions.

In addition to a competitive salary, Graphcore offers flexible working and a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, wellbeing and financial future. Our benefits include medical, dental and vision coverage, Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs), Health Savings Accounts (HSAs), disability and life insurance, a 401(k) retirement plan, commuter benefits, wellness services and an Employee Assistance Programme (EAP). We welcome people of different backgrounds and experiences; we're committed to building an inclusive work environment that makes Graphcore a great home for everyone. We offer an equal opportunity process and understand that there are visible and invisible differences in all of us. We can provide a flexible approach to interview and encourage you to chat to us if you require any reasonable adjustments.

postings.title: AI Research Engineer
postings.description:
About Graphcore

At Graphcore, we’re building the future of AI compute.We’re a team of semiconductor, software and AI experts, with deep experience in creating the complete AI compute stack - from silicon and software to infrastructure at datacenter scale.As part of the SoftBank Group, backed by significant long-term investment, we are delivering key technology into the fast-growing SoftBank AI ecosystem.To meet the vast and exciting AI opportunity, Graphcore is expanding its teams around the world.We are bringing together the brightest minds to solve the toughest problems, in a place where everyone has the opportunity to make an impact on the company, our products and the future of artificial intelligence.

Job Summary

As a research engineer at Graphcore, you will contribute to the advancement of AI research, investigating new ideas that push the limits on important AI/ML problems. Specialised hardware has been the key driver of the progress of AI over the last decade, and we believe that hardware-aware AI algorithms and AI-aware hardware developments will continue to be critical to advancing this exciting field. We are therefore looking for individuals who combine strong machine learning experience with practical engineering skills to deliver impactful AI research. We are seeking AI researchers with strong software engineering experience, particularly in lower-level programming and performance optimisation for hardware efficiency. Our research spans a broad range of topics, including efficient training and inference, world models, life sciences, reinforcement learning, and beyond. You will work closely with researchers to generate ideas and translate them into scalable implementations, contributing to publications and projects that help to steer the future of AI hardware.

The Team

Graphcore Research participates in both fundamental and applied research, to characterise the computational requirements of machine intelligence and to demonstrate how hardware can drive the next generation of innovative AI models. We publish at leading AI/ML conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR) as well as specialist workshops, and collaborate with other research teams and organisations across the world.

We pride ourselves on being a supportive and collaborative team, where we organise around our individual research interests to solve problems together in domains such as efficient compute, model scaling and distributed training and inference of AI models for multiple modalities and applications, including for sequence- and graph-based data. We’re based across London, Cambridge and Bristol, with projects and discussions that involve all our locations.

Perhaps the best way to get an idea of what we’re all about is to read one of our papers or an article on our blog. If you’re excited to work at the cutting edge of AI supported by new hardware and want to develop your skills in this area, we’d love to hear from you!

Responsibilities and Duties

- Generate AI/ML ideas, design experiments, implement them & evaluate results.

- Prepare, submit & present your work to AI conferences and workshops.

- Provide technical insight to internal teams by designing experiments and delivering clear, actionable reports.

- Collaborate with researchers, silicon and software engineers at Graphcore to help define, build and test Graphcore’s next generation of AI hardware.

About you:

Essential:

- Master’s, PhD or equivalent experience in a technical discipline (e.g., Maths, Statistics, Computer Science, Physics, Chemistry).

- Python programming in a modern deep learning framework, e.g. PyTorch or JAX.

- Familiar with deep learning fundamentals: models, optimisation, evaluation and scaling.

- Capable of designing, executing and reporting from ML experiments.

- Lower-level programming for hardware efficiency, e.g. C++/CUDA/Triton.

- Practical familiarity with hardware capabilities for deep learning – threads, caches, vector & matrix engines, data dependencies, bus widths and throttling.

- Practical familiarity with software stacks for deep learning – compilation, kernel fusion, XLA/ATen ops, streams, and asynchronous execution

Desirable:

- Mathematics skills to support the above: calculus, probability theory and linear algebra.

- Experience submitting papers to international scientific conferences or workshops.

Benefits

In addition to a competitive salary, Graphcore offers flexible working, a generous annual leave policy, private medical insurance and health cash plan, a dental plan, pension (matched up to 5%), life assurance and income protection. We have a generous parental leave policy and an employee assistance programme (which includes health, mental wellbeing, and bereavement support). We offer a range of healthy food and snacks at our central Bristol office and have our own barista bar! We welcome people of different backgrounds and experiences; we’re committed to building an inclusive work environment that makes Graphcore a great home for everyone. We offer an equal opportunity process and understand that there are visible and invisible differences in all of us. We can provide a flexible approach to interview and encourage you to chat to us if you require any reasonable adjustments.

Applicants for this position must hold the right to work in the UK. Unfortunately at this time, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support for visa applications

postings.title: AI Technology PhD Research Internship
postings.location: Bristol, UK; Cambridge, UK; London, UK
postings.description:
Location: UK based from either our Bristol, Cambridge or London office.

Research PhD Internship 

Explore a research career at Graphcore through a PhD internship, gaining hands-on experience on real projects. You’ll bring fresh ideas, put your learning into practice and help shape what we’re creating. Along the way, you’ll tackle challenging problems with a team who welcome your questions and support you as you build your skills and confidence.

What you’ll work on

Explore how your research could inform the next generation of AI compute, working alongside researchers tackling questions shaped by real-world hardware and software challenges.

Our team is interested in numerous topics across the field, working on problems where algorithms, hardware, and systems meet. These topics include large-scale pretraining and post-training of LLMs, efficient inference, numerics, world models, molecule generation for life science applications, and model safety and interpretability. Across all these directions, you’ll come up with new ideas, implement models and algorithms, design experiments, and present your findings (often in the form of a paper).

You’ll have room to follow promising ideas and help shape your research direction, with mentoring as you test your thinking. Your work could contribute to public research shared with the wider AI community.

Your team and support

Graphcore Research explores the computational requirements of machine intelligence and how hardware can enable the next generation of AI models. The team publishes at leading AI and machine learning conferences, including NeurIPS, ICML and ICLR.

You’ll learn alongside researchers working across a wide range of AI topics. Mentoring and open research discussions will give you opportunities to explore ideas, get feedback and decide which questions to pursue.

Decisions are shaped by experimental evidence and technical discussion. As an intern, you’ll be encouraged to ask questions, challenge assumptions and share results early, with support from experienced researchers as you develop your ideas.

How you’ll learn and grow

Over the internship, you’ll build research experience by taking a question through experimentation, implementation and analysis.

You’ll develop your judgement about what a result tells you, which ideas deserve further investigation and how to communicate your findings clearly. Exploring both theory and practical experiments will help you understand how your research connects to AI models, hardware and systems, and where you’d like to take it next.

What we're looking for 

- Currently studying for a PhD specialising in AI or machine learning.

- Strong coding ability in Python or C++, demonstrated through projects, research or other practical experience

- Experience implementing algorithms in machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch

- The ability to design experiments, interpret results and communicate research clearly, with curiosity about both theory and practical experimentation

Previous industry experience is not required. Tell us about a research question you explored, how you approached it and what you learned through your experiments.

Benefits

- Flexible working: Find a balance between your internship and life outside work

- Life in the office: Get to know your colleagues in spaces designed for collaboration, with free food and a great selection of ice cream!

- Develop your research in an industry setting, exchanging ideas with experienced researchers and engineers

We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.

Sponsorship

Applicants must already have the right to work in the UK for the full duration of the programme, without requiring visa sponsorship. We are unable to sponsor work visas for our Early Careers opportunities.

Introduction to Graphcore

At Graphcore, we’re building next generation AI compute: from semiconductors and software to systems at datacenter scale. We are proud to be owned by SoftBank Group and work with other companies in the SoftBank family to deliver AI compute to customers working at the AI frontier.

An internship at Graphcore gives you the chance to explore where your interests and skills could take you. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds and expertise, from AI researchers to chip designers and software engineers. Together, you’ll share ideas and solve challenging problems, building experience and confidence to help you decide what comes next.

Curious about where your skills could take you? Apply for a PhD internship at Graphcore and help us build what comes next.

postings.title: Asset & Logistics Specialist
postings.description:
Asset & Logistics Specialist works closely with engineering, construction, facilities, finance, legal, supply chain and site operations to ensure technical equipment and services are commercially sound, delivered when required and accurately managed throughout their lifecycle. 

The Team 

The Asset & Logistics team supports Data Center Engineering by coordinating the procurement, movement, management and lifecycle of equipment required to build, commission, operate and maintain data-center and laboratory environments. 

Working closely with technical and operational teams, the team helps ensure equipment is available when needed, supplier and logistics issues are resolved effectively, asset information is accurate and purchasing activities support infrastructure delivery. 

Responsibilities and Duties 

- Lead day-to-day sourcing and purchasing activities for data-center and laboratory equipment, infrastructure, technical services and facility requirements. 

- Translate engineering specifications, bills of materials, construction schedules and operational requirements into clear purchasing and supplier activities. 

- Review supplier quotations, technical scopes, pricing, lead times, warranties, delivery requirements and commercial risks. 

- Negotiate pricing, payment terms, delivery conditions, warranties, service commitments and other commercial terms within agreed parameters. 

- Coordinate supplier onboarding, compliance reviews, confidentiality agreements, internal approvals, purchase orders and supporting contract documentation. 

- Implement sourcing and purchasing plans that support project schedules, local site requirements and supplier availability. 

- Identify and resolve supplier issues that could affect cost, equipment availability, construction schedules, commissioning or site readiness. 

- Lead and support the Asset & Logistics team, setting clear priorities, coordinating workloads and helping team members deliver effectively. 

- Oversee equipment receipt, identification, storage, installation, commissioning, transfer, maintenance and retirement. 

- Coordinate freight, receiving, rigging, storage, delivery scheduling and domestic and international movement of equipment. 

- Maintain accurate asset records covering equipment location, ownership, serial numbers, purchase orders, warranties, service agreements and operating status. 

- Coordinate equipment delivery and installation activities with suppliers, construction partners, commissioning teams and site personnel. 

- Resolve delayed, damaged, incomplete or incorrectly delivered equipment issues. 

- Reconcile purchase orders, invoices, change orders, payments, budget commitments and remaining balances, working with relevant teams to resolve discrepancies. 

- Partner with engineering, finance, legal, facilities, construction, supply chain and accounts payable teams to resolve commercial and operational issues. 

- Produce clear reporting and dashboards covering purchasing activity, asset status, delivery performance, supplier risk, financial commitments and infrastructure readiness. 

- Communicate risks, mitigation actions, decisions and resource requirements to relevant stakeholders. 

- Identify and implement practical improvements to procurement, asset management, logistics and reporting processes. 

Candidate Profile 

Essential 

- Significant experience in technical procurement, strategic sourcing, supply chain, asset operations, logistics or critical infrastructure environments. 

- Data-center experience, with a good understanding of construction, commissioning and operational requirements and relevant electrical, cooling, rack and facility infrastructure. 

- Experience leading a team or coordinating the work of others within procurement, asset management or logistics. 

- Strong commercial and negotiation experience, including supplier pricing, payment terms, warranties, service commitments and delivery conditions. 

- Ability to interpret technical requirements, equipment specifications, bills of materials, construction schedules and commissioning requirements. 

- Experience managing supplier performance and resolving commercial, delivery and operational issues. 

- Good financial and analytical capability, including experience reconciling purchase orders, invoices, budgets, payment records and capital commitments. 

- Proven ability to work effectively across engineering, finance, legal, facilities, construction, supply chain and other stakeholder groups. 

- Experience developing reporting or dashboards covering procurement activity, financial commitments, asset status, supplier performance and delivery risk. 

- Strong judgement, communication, negotiation and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities. 

- Proficiency with purchasing systems, financial platforms, asset databases, spreadsheets, workflow tools and reporting applications. 

- Bachelor’s degree in engineering, supply chain, business, construction, operations, finance or a related field. 

- Project Management Professional (PMP) certification. 

Desirable 

- Master’s degree in engineering, supply chain, business administration, construction, operations, finance or a related field. 

- Experience sourcing electrical, cooling, mechanical, controls, rack, hardware or commissioning requirements for data-center environments. 

- Experience coordinating international freight, equipment storage, rigging, site delivery, installation and commissioning. 

- Knowledge of capital-expenditure controls, statements of work, change orders, asset governance, warranties and supplier-performance measurement. 

- Experience improving procurement, asset management or logistics processes across multiple locations.

postings.title: Board Test Development Engineer
postings.description:
About the job

Expose manufacturing defects in Graphcore’s advanced circuit boards with tests you build and deploy.

Based in Bristol, UK, you’ll develop board and PCBA hardware tests that help turn complex designs into reliable products. You’ll take tests from initial design analysis to deployment, then support them in factories and the field.

Better defect coverage means more opportunities to identify manufacturing problems and understand hardware failures when products are in use. You’ll help make test and inspection methods work together, targeting the ways advanced electronic assemblies can go wrong.

You’ll examine PCB testability and susceptibility to manufacturing defects, then use that analysis to define and develop test solutions. You’ll build boundary scan and embedded functional tests, turning your understanding of board behaviour into practical diagnostic tools.

The team and culture

The Product Test and Diagnosis team tackles hardware defects across chips, boards and finished systems. You’ll work directly with Hardware Design, Manufacturing Operations and contract electronics manufacturers, connecting design knowledge with factory experience.

Use evidence to guide test decisions, challenge gaps in coverage and take responsibility for moving improvements forward. Move quickly from diagnosis to action, bringing the right people together to resolve hardware problems.

What we're looking for

- Strong electronics fundamentals, particularly digital electronics.

- Commercial experience in board or PCBA hardware testing.

- Understanding of manufacturing test for advanced electronic systems.

- Knowledge of surface-mount technology (SMT), PCB manufacturing processes and their failure mechanisms.

- Understanding of automated optical inspection (AOI) and automated X-ray inspection (AXI) capabilities.

- Ability to diagnose electronic defects to component level.

While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences. We also welcome engineers returning to the profession after a career break, including through returnship routes.

Benefits

· Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility
· Generous leave: Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work
· Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension
· Phantom equity: Share in Graphcore’s success
· Workplace experience: Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day
· Peace of mind protection: Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones
· Electric Vehicle Scheme: Choose an electric vehicle and lease it through salary sacrifice
· Flexible benefits: Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance and dental cover
· Optional benefits: Dental cover, health cash plan, private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme, give as you earn

We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.
We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.

Sponsorship

Applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa applications for this role. 

Join the Team at Graphcore

Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.

As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.

Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore brings together deep expertise to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful progress in AI compute. 

Ready to put your board test expertise behind reliable Graphcore hardware? Apply now to join our Bristol team.

postings.title: Cloud Platform Summer Intern 2027
postings.description:
Location: Bristol, UK 
Duration: 12 weeks 
Salary: £2500 per month 
Start date: June 2027 
Application deadline: Midnight 29th November 
We encourage you to apply early, as we may close applications before the advertised deadline. 

The Internship Programme at Graphcore 

Explore a career at Graphcore through a 12-week summer internship, gaining hands-on experience on real projects. You’ll bring fresh ideas, put your learning into practice and help shape what we’re creating. Along the way, you’ll tackle challenging problems with a team who welcome your questions and support you as you build your skills and confidence. 

What you’ll be doing 

Put your Linux and scripting foundations to work exploring the cloud platforms that support Graphcore’s AI systems. 

As a Cloud Platform Engineering Intern, you’ll help deploy, test and monitor services across private and public cloud environments. You’ll contribute through clearly scoped tasks, with guidance from experienced engineers as you build confidence. 

Your tasks could include writing or improving scripts, reviewing metrics and logs, investigating issues and documenting what you learn. You’ll see how automation and monitoring help the team manage high-performance AI infrastructure and how continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) and Infrastructure-as-Code are used in real systems. 

Your team and support 

The Cloud Platform team provides large-scale AI systems through private and public cloud services. Its work brings together Graphcore AI systems, industry-standard servers, switches and storage. Some environments use pre-release hardware and software, giving you a view of how new technology becomes usable. 

You’ll work alongside experienced engineers through sprint activities, technical reviews, project demonstrations and practical investigations. You can ask for help as you learn, share your progress and use feedback to improve your work on defined tasks. 

Decisions are shaped by evidence, engineering judgement and open discussion. As an intern, you’ll be encouraged to ask questions early, share what you find and try out ideas, with support from experienced engineers as you learn. 

How you’ll learn and grow 

Over the 12 weeks, you’ll build practical experience with Linux systems, scripting, automation and monitoring through the work your tasks focus on. 

Investigating issues with logs and metrics will help you develop a methodical approach to problem solving and understand how cloud services fit together. Technical reviews and project demonstrations will help you explain your findings, learn from feedback and explore whether platform engineering is a direction you’d like to pursue. 

Your internship is a chance to explore a future at Graphcore. Depending on your performance and the roles available, there may be an opportunity to join one of our graduate programmes once you’ve graduated. 

What we’re looking for

postings.title: Director, Post-Silicon Validation
postings.description:
Graphcore is a globally recognized leader in Artificial Intelligence computing systems. The company designs advanced semiconductors and datacentre hardware that provide the specialized processing power needed to drive AI innovation, while delivering the efficiency required to support its broader adoption.

As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, we are working to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure that its benefits are accessible to everyone.

We are developing the next generation of AI compute, a large-scale system-on-chip (SoC) designed to power future high-performance AI systems. As the Director of Post Silicon Validation, you will be responsible for leading the Bristol team, enabling pre-production software to run reliably on new silicon quickly and efficiently, before showing that the silicon meets the highest standards of quality, reliability and functionality, ready for production deployment.

Reporting to the Senior Director of Post Silicon Validation, you will manage, develop and grow the Post Silicon Validation team in Bristol, delivering post-silicon validation across the full AI SoC, working across silicon, firmware, and platform levels. The role requires a deep technical understanding, strong hands-on debug experience, and the ability to collaborate effectively with hardware, software, and systems engineering teams.

Responsibilities

- Manage, develop and grow the Post Silicon Validation team in Bristol: The Post Silicon Validation team is relatively new, with a strong remit and growing quickly to help Graphcore bring up new silicon quickly and effectively.

- Play a significant role in the definition, planning and execution of chip bringup activities: Develop and refine the overall post-silicon validation approach for our AI SoCs, ensuring reliable and timely delivery of validated silicon, architectural correctness, feature robustness, and at-scale system reliability.

- Drive cross-domain debug and issue resolution: Lead investigation and resolution of complex issues spanning silicon, firmware, operating systems, and platform interactions. Ensure that fixes are effective and sustainable.

- Promote collaboration and shared understanding: Work closely with design, software, and validation teams to align on quality objectives and debug priorities. Use data-driven insights and clear communication to maintain focus and alignment across teams.

- Advance automation and scalable validation: Encourage the use of emulation, prototyping, and large-scale validation infrastructure to improve coverage and reduce time to debug.

- Support continuous improvement: Foster a culture that values learning, transparency, and improvement in validation methods, automation, and analysis.

- Engage with leadership and partners: Provide clear and concise updates on validation progress, risks, and quality indicators to executive teams and key partners. Contribute to product readiness assessments and roadmap decisions

Essential skills

- Building and running high performing teams

- A systems thinker, comfortable working across hardware, software, and integration boundaries

- A collaborative leader who builds trust and alignment across diverse teams

- Skilled in technical problem solving and debugging complex post-silicon issues

- A clear communicator who can simplify complexity and support sound decision-making in fast-paced environments

- Proven experience leading post-silicon validation and bring-up for complex SoCs (AI, GPU, or CPU)

- Strong understanding of SoC architecture, coherency protocols, power management, and interconnects

- Expertise in debug tools, DFT infrastructure, and validation automation frameworks

- Proficient in C/C++, Python, and Linux-based environments; experience with large-scale validation clusters is an advantage

postings.title: Finance Manager APAC
postings.description:
About the Company

Graphcore is a globally recognised leader in Artificial Intelligence computing systems. The company designs advanced semiconductors and data centre hardware that provide the specialised processing power needed to drive AI innovation, while delivering the efficiency required to support its broader adoption. As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. We are opening a new AI Engineering Campus in Bengaluru, which will play a central role in Graphcore's work, building the future of AI computing.

The Role

The Senior Finance Manager – APAC will be responsible for overseeing the finance operations of Graphcore's APAC entities, initially India and Taiwan. Based in Bangalore, this role will provide financial leadership across the region while partnering closely with outsourced accounting providers, the UK Group Finance team and local business leaders.

This is a broad, hands-on finance leadership role with responsibility for financial governance, statutory compliance, payroll oversight, treasury, business partnering and internal controls across the region. Whilst transactional accounting and local bookkeeping activities are performed by external service providers, the Senior Finance Manager retains ownership for the quality and integrity of the financial information, ensuring local accounting complies with Group policies and statutory requirements.

The role will oversee monthly reporting from the outsourced accounting providers, manage the integration of local financial information into Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central for Group reporting, and support the continued development of scalable finance processes and controls as Graphcore expands across APAC.

Reporting to the VP Finance in the UK, this position will work closely with the wider Global Finance team, People, Facilities and local leadership to ensure Finance provides an outstanding service to the business.

Key Responsibilities

Finance Operations & Governance

- Manage the relationship with outsourced finance providers in India and Taiwan, ensuring agreed service levels are delivered.

- Review and approve monthly management accounts prepared by external accounting providers.

- Ensure local accounting complies with Group accounting policies and statutory requirements.

- Review balance sheet reconciliations and oversee resolution of accounting issues.

- Act as the finance lead for the APAC entities, ensuring robust governance and financial control.

Group Reporting

- Coordinate monthly financial reporting from local accounting providers.

- Reconcile local statutory accounts to Group reporting.

- Support month-end close activities and Group reporting requirements.

- Support future integration of APAC entities into the Group ERP environment.

Statutory Compliance, Payroll & Treasury

- Oversee statutory accounting, tax compliance and regulatory reporting across the APAC entities.

Business Partnering & Local Support

- Provide guidance to employees on Company finance policies, including travel, expenses, purchasing and procurement.

- Support budgeting, forecasting and financial planning for the APAC entities.

- Provide commercial insight and financial guidance to support business decision-making.

Financial Controls & Process Improvement

- Design, implement and maintain local financial controls to complement Group policies and meet local statutory requirements.

- Develop controls for locally managed assets, including fixed asset registers, asset tracking and periodic verification.

- Ensure appropriate approval workflows exist for purchasing, expenses, payroll and payments.

- Drive continuous improvement in finance processes, documentation and reporting.

- Support finance transformation initiatives, including future ERP implementation and process automation.

Global Finance Collaboration

- Act as the primary liaison between the APAC entities and the UK Group Finance team.

- Support Group audits and other corporate finance initiatives.

- Share best practice and contribute to the ongoing development of the global finance function.

- Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA), CPA or equivalent professional accounting qualification.

- 6+ years' post-qualified experience, ideally within an international technology, semiconductor or engineering organisation.

- Experience managing or overseeing outsourced accounting providers or shared service finance operations.

- Strong knowledge of statutory accounting, financial reporting and internal controls.

- Experience working with multinational organisations and multiple legal entities.

- Experience of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central or a comparable ERP system would be advantageous.

- Strong Excel and financial analysis skills. 

- Experience working with external auditors, tax advisers and payroll providers.

- Experience supporting month-end reporting and Group consolidations.

- Experience in designing or using agentic workflows to improve finance processes would also be highly beneficial.

Skills & Competencies

- Excellent stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.

- Strong commercial awareness with the ability to partner effectively with business leaders.

- Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities across countries and time zones.

- High attention to detail with a strong focus on financial governance and controls.

The Internship Programme at Graphcore

Explore a career at Graphcore through a 12-week summer internship, gaining hands-on experience on real projects. You’ll bring fresh ideas, put your learning into practice and help shape what we’re creating. Along the way, you’ll tackle challenging problems with a team who welcome your questions and support you as you build your skills and confidence.

Put your programming skills to work exploring how firmware brings AI hardware to life, from first boot to system monitoring.

As a Firmware Engineering Intern, you’ll contribute to firmware for Graphcore’s next-generation products. Working closely to with our silicon and hardware teams, you’ll contribute to software that supports hardware bootup and provides telemetry and monitoring data that helps data centre operators understand what the hardware is doing.

Your tasks could include writing code, develop unit tests and investigate behaviour on hardware using logs, oscilloscopes and logic analysers. You’ll contribute to a shared codebase and see how software decisions affect physical systems.

Your team and support

The Firmware team sits within System Software and works with teams across Graphcore and our partners. You’ll report to the Firmware Manager and work alongside engineers connecting silicon, hardware and software.

Technical discussions, code reviews and Agile working practices will help you understand design decisions and how the team coordinates its work. You can ask for help as you learn the codebase, explain your thinking and use feedback to improve your work.

Decisions are shaped by technical discussion and investigation. As an intern, you’ll be encouraged to ask questions, raise issues early and share what you learn, with support from experienced engineers as you try out different approaches.

How you’ll learn and grow

Over the 12 weeks, you’ll build practical experience in firmware development, unit testing and debugging through the work your tasks focus on.

Investigating issues on real hardware will help you connect software behaviour with physical signals and develop a methodical approach to finding problems. Code reviews will introduce you to shared development and coding standards and help you build confidence contributing to a team codebase, giving you a clearer view of a career in embedded software.

Your internship is a chance to explore a future at Graphcore. Depending on your performance and the roles available, there may be an opportunity to join one of our graduate programmes once you’ve graduated.

What we’re looking for

- Currently studying towards a bachelor’s or master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Electronic Engineering, Maths or a related field. Equivalent experience is also welcome

- Introductory programming experience in C or Python, with some understanding of continuous integration, build systems and software packaging best practices

- A practical, methodical approach to problem solving, with the ability to organise your work and follow tasks through to completion

- Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to document complex system designs coherently

postings.description:
Hardware Design Senior Manager 

Bristol, UK

About the job

Lead the engineers behind the power, timing and control circuits that make Graphcore’s AI compute hardware work.

Your team’s schematics, component choices and electrical constraints will give PCB layout engineers complete inputs for implementing each design. You’ll help test and manufacturing teams understand expected behaviour, resolve circuit issues and take hardware through to production.

You’ll line-manage engineers, coach their development and agree achievable commitments, matching the work to available capacity. You’ll coordinate reviews and investigations, ensure corrective actions reach closure and plan ahead for tools, licences and compute resources.

Grow your leadership across the hardware lifecycle, drawing on specialist expertise rather than becoming the technical authority for every circuit. Build a more autonomous team whose methods and shared knowledge improve how Graphcore develops its next generation of hardware.

The team and culture

You’ll connect Hardware Design with SI/PI, PCB layout, mechanical, thermal, systems and firmware engineers across locations. Programme management owns the integrated plan; you’ll flag competing priorities early and bring practical options for resolving them.

Technical owners help agree operating conditions, margins and acceptance criteria. You’ll encourage engineers to challenge assumptions, using evidence and specialist advice to resolve difficult trade-offs.

- People leadership that develops engineers, delegates effectively and addresses difficult performance issues, with readiness for formal line management.

- Experience coordinating engineering delivery with programme management, including estimates, work allocation, dependencies and capacity, with sound judgement under schedule pressure.

- Communication that builds relationships across disciplines and locations, resolves competing expectations and secures decisions by explaining risks and trade-offs.

- A strong hardware engineering background spanning circuit and schematic development, board implementation, verification and production transition. An engineering degree or equivalent practical experience.

- Understanding of power supplies, sequencing, reset, clocks, digital interfaces and SI/PI constraints, with judgement about when specialist input is needed.

postings.description:
About the job

Build the hardware that turns new AI processors into working systems.

As a Hardware Development Engineer, you will design circuit solutions for Graphcore processor systems and validation platforms. You will turn system requirements into schematics, layout constraints, and testable hardware.

Your work will shape production systems and test boards used across development, validation, and customer enablement. You will help prove performance, margin, and reliability before designs move into volume production.

Alongside silicon, architecture, software and PCB CAD specialists, you will make design decisions grounded in evidence. You will define validation plans, run lab campaigns, debug prototypes, and interpret results with firmware and architecture teams.

This role suits someone who likes owning problems from first schematic to mass production readiness. Few roles connect board design, bring-up, validation, and production so directly.

The team and culture

Hardware Engineering builds production systems and test hardware around Graphcore processors. The team works close to silicon, architecture, firmware, software, and PCB CAD from the first requirement onwards.

Engineers own designs through definition, schematic capture, layout support, bring-up, validation, and production transfer. Work moves quickly because problems are handled close to the lab, not passed between silos.

The team makes decisions through evidence: measurements, design reviews, margin data, and open technical challenge. You will speak up, take responsibility, and help the team move with confidence.

What we're looking for

· Strong digital circuit design and validation skills, including DCDC regulators, power delivery, resets, clocks, and control interfaces.
· Experience developing processor-based systems and working with interfaces such as Ethernet, PCIe, DDR, USB, QSPI and JTAG.
· Practical lab depth in bring-up, debug, margin testing, and validation using oscilloscopes, logic analysers and signal generators.
· Ability to script tests and analyse results using Linux, Python, Bash and Excel.
· Understanding of server architecture, such as BMC, NIC and SSD, with SERDES experience adding further value.
· Ownership mindset, clear communication, and the confidence to challenge, decide, and work across disciplines.

While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences. If you meet most of our essential criteria, we encourage you to submit an application and showcase how your background makes you a strong candidate.

postings.description:
Location: Bristol, UK
Duration: 12 weeks
Salary: £2500 per month
Start date: June 2027
Applications deadline: Midnight, 29th November
We encourage you to apply early, as we may close applications before the advertised deadline.

The Internship Programme at Graphcore

Explore a career at Graphcore through a 12-week summer internship, gaining hands-on experience on real projects. You’ll bring fresh ideas, put your learning into practice and help shape what we’re creating. Along the way, you’ll tackle challenging problems with a team who welcome your questions and support you as you build your skills and confidence.

What you’ll be doing

Put your engineering foundations to work exploring the electronic hardware behind Graphcore’s AI compute platforms.

Your internship could focus on Hardware Design, Signal Integrity or elements of both, depending on your interests, the available projects and how your strengths develop. You’ll contribute to a clearly scoped design, analysis, validation or debugging task, with guidance as you work towards a conclusion supported by evidence.

In Hardware Design, your tasks could include schematic and circuit design, component evaluation, PCB development, board bring-up or laboratory testing. You could help check power rails and clocks, exercise interfaces, investigate faults or develop test and debug access.

In Signal Integrity, you could explore high-speed links such as PCIe and Ethernet, DDR and other memory interfaces, or clocks and timing-critical signals. Tasks could include reviewing PCB layouts and routing, simulating interconnect behaviour or comparing laboratory measurements with analysis to understand design trade-offs.

Your team and support

Hardware Design and Signal Integrity engineers work closely with PCB layout, silicon, validation, firmware, mechanical and thermal engineering, manufacturing and system teams. You’ll see how different engineering perspectives come together to make complex boards work.

Staff Hardware Engineers and Team Leads will support you with clearly scoped work and regular technical guidance. You can ask for help as you explore unfamiliar concepts, discuss your findings and use feedback to improve your approach.

Decisions are shaped by simulation, measurement and engineering judgement. As an intern, you’ll be encouraged to ask questions, speak up and try out ideas early, with support from experienced engineers as you learn.

How you’ll learn and grow

Over the 12 weeks, you’ll connect your studies with how boards are designed, analysed, brought up and validated. Your project will help you develop a methodical approach to defining a problem, testing your thinking and explaining what the evidence shows.

You’ll gain exposure to professional tools such as Mentor Expedition, Ansys HFSS and Keysight ADS, as relevant to your work. Comparing simulations, design choices and laboratory results will help you understand how real hardware behaves and which areas of hardware engineering you’d like to explore further.

Your internship is a chance to explore a future at Graphcore. Depending on your performance and the roles available, there may be an opportunity to join one of our graduate programmes once you’ve graduated.

What we're looking for

- Currently studying towards a degree in Electronic Engineering, Electrical and Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics or a closely related technical discipline

- Strong electrical and electronic engineering foundations, with an interest in hardware design or signal integrity and how real electronic systems work

- A logical, first-principles approach to unfamiliar problems, with practical engineering experience from university projects, laboratory work, personal projects or activities such as Formula Student, robotics or engineering societies

- The ability to work with measurements or technical data and explain your conclusions clearly, with curiosity, willingness to take ownership and openness to feedback and collaboration

postings.title: Infrastructure and MLOps Engineer
postings.description:
About Graphcore 

At Graphcore, we’re building the future of AI compute.

We’re a team of semiconductor, software and AI experts, with deep experience in creating the complete AI compute stack - from silicon and software to infrastructure at datacenter scale.

As part of the SoftBank Group, backed by significant long-term investment, we are delivering key technology into the fast-growing SoftBank AI ecosystem.To meet the vast and exciting AI opportunity, Graphcore is expanding its teams around the world.We are bringing together the brightest minds to solve the toughest problems, in a place where everyone has the opportunity to make an impact on the company, our products and the future of artificial intelligence.

Job Summary 

Join our dynamic Software Infrastructure team and take a pivotal role in scaling and managing our infrastructure. You will develop essential tools and services that empower our broader software team. Your contributions will enhance the build, test, deployment, and productisation processes of our Machine Learning Software components. Work with our High-Performance Computing (HPC) AI platforms and gain invaluable experience in distributed systems

The Team

The Software Infrastructure team provides critical platforms and services for software development teams across the business. Our responsibilities include managing the CI platform and services, build engineering, component integration, and packaging and release systems. We operate in squads, fostering a culture of service ownership and empowerment for our engineers. We focus on long-term engineering solutions and strive to eliminate toil wherever possible. 

Responsibilities and Duties 

- Develop, own, and maintain tools and services to support AI research and engineering teams 

- Deploy and maintain services with Kubernetes and Docker 

- Manage our Cloud Infrastructure using tools such as Terraform 

Candidate Profile 

Essential: 

- Knowledge of Python 

- Familiarity with cloud services (e.g. AWS) 

- Experience managing or developing in Linux environments 

- Understanding of CI/CD principles 

- Experience using Kubernetes (k8s) 

- Experience of one of the following:

- maintaining machine learning applications.

- deploying ML orchestration tools (e.g. NV Ray, KFP, SkyPilot).

- managing ML accelerator hardware (e.g. DCGM).

Desirable 

- Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools (e.g. Terraform/OpenTofu) 

- Experience with GitHub Actions 

- Experience with modern observability tooling (e.g. Prometheus) 

- Experience with Grafana 

- Knowledge of Go/Java/C++ (or similar language)

Benefits

In addition to a competitive salary, Graphcore offers flexible working, a generous annual leave policy, private medical insurance and health cash plan, a dental plan, pension (matched up to 5%), life assurance and income protection. We have a generous parental leave policy and an employee assistance programme (which includes health, mental wellbeing, and bereavement support). We offer a range of healthy food and snacks at our central Bristol office and have our own barista bar! We welcome people of different backgrounds and experiences; we’re committed to building an inclusive work environment that makes Graphcore a great home for everyone. We offer an equal opportunity process and understand that there are visible and invisible differences in all of us. We can provide a flexible approach to interview and encourage you to chat to us if you require any reasonable adjustments.

postings.title: Lab Technician
postings.description:
About the job

Keep Graphcore’s Bristol laboratories safe, reliable and ready for engineers to test AI hardware.

As a Lab Technician in DC Engineering, you’ll support the facilities behind hardware bring-up, validation and characterisation. You’ll help engineering teams use electronic systems and test equipment safely and effectively.

Your preventative maintenance and troubleshooting will help keep laboratory equipment available for engineers’ work. By checking electrostatic discharge controls, you’ll help protect the hardware being developed and tested.

You’ll set up and calibrate test equipment, manage laboratory assets, and support board, cable and wire modifications. You’ll also oversee goods coming into and leaving the laboratories.

Beyond equipment support, you’ll shape standard operating procedures for multidisciplinary laboratory teams. Your technical guidance will help colleagues meet safety, quality and regulatory requirements in their everyday work.

The team and culture

The Laboratory team supports engineering groups with installations, repairs and equipment modifications. You’ll work with engineers to understand their technical requirements and get test benches ready within project timescales.

The team maintains accurate technical documentation and works to defined laboratory practices. You’ll contribute practical guidance and help junior colleagues develop their skills.

What we’re looking for

- Experience working in an electronics laboratory and a practical, resourceful approach to technical problems.

- Ability to set up, calibrate and troubleshoot electronic test equipment, including oscilloscopes, logic analysers and power supplies.

- Understanding of electrostatic discharge (ESD) controls and laboratory health and safety requirements, with experience applying safe working practices.

- Experience repairing and modifying PCB assemblies to IPC-7711/21 and J-STD-001 standards, and inspecting assemblies to IPC-A-610.

- Experience assembling cables and wire harnesses from drawings to IPC-620 standards.

- Clear communication across engineering disciplines, with the ability to meet project timescales and mentor junior colleagues.

While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences. We also welcome engineers returning to the profession after a career break, including through returnship routes.

Benefits

- Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility

postings.title: Manufacturing Operations (Product Test) Summer Intern 2027
postings.description:
Duration: 12 weeks 
Salary: £2500 per month 
Start date: June 2027 
Applications deadline: Midnight 29th November 
We encourage you to apply early, as we may close applications before the advertised deadline. 

The Internship Programme at Graphcore 

Explore a career at Graphcore through a 12-week summer internship, gaining hands-on experience on real projects. You’ll bring fresh ideas, put your learning into practice and help shape what we’re creating. Along the way, you’ll tackle challenging problems with a team who welcome your questions and support you as you build your skills and confidence. 

What you’ll work on 

Put your engineering foundations to work exploring how advanced AI hardware is tested, diagnosed and improved. 

As a Test Engineering Intern in our Product Test and Diagnosis team, you’ll contribute to practical work across silicon, boards, server blades or rack-scale systems. Depending on your project, you may develop automated test solutions, run system-level tests and analyse the results. 

Your work will help the team improve how Graphcore tests and understands its products. It’s a chance to see how manufacturing test connects design, validation and performance in use, while contributing to a defined project or set of activities. 

Your team and support 

You’ll join the Product Test and Diagnosis team in Bristol, within Manufacturing Operations. The wider team spans Bristol, Cambridge, India, the US and Taiwan, developing test strategies across the full product lifecycle. 

You’ll work alongside experienced engineers on practical tasks close to the hardware. You can ask for help as you investigate results and develop tools, with support as you take ownership of your project or activities. 

Decisions are shaped by test results, clear data and thoughtful problem solving. As an intern, you’ll be encouraged to ask questions, share your findings and try out ideas, with support from experienced engineers as you learn. 

How you’ll learn and grow 

Over the 12 weeks, you’ll build practical experience in semiconductor test and diagnosis through the work your project focuses on. 

Running tests, analysing data and investigating issues will help you connect your studies with real hardware, develop your technical judgement and explain your findings. Working with engineers who improve test tools and processes will give you a clearer view of the areas you enjoy and might want to explore further. 

Your internship is a chance to explore a future at Graphcore. Depending on your performance and the roles available, there may be an opportunity to join one of our graduate programmes once you’ve graduated. 

What we’re looking for 

- Currently studying for a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical or Electronic Engineering, Physics, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience 

- An understanding of electronics or printed circuit board (PCB) fundamentals, with an interest in semiconductor technology, manufacturing, test or validation 

- Programming or scripting experience, ideally with Python 

- The ability to use data to investigate problems and communicate your findings, demonstrated through practical work involving electronics, embedded systems, validation, or automation 

Previous industry experience is not required. Tell us what you built or investigated through university projects, laboratory work, research, personal projects or other relevant experience, how you approached it and what you learned. 

Familiarity with Linux, Bash or Git would be useful. These are additional strengths, rather than essential requirements. 

Benefits 

- Flexible working: Find a balance between your internship and life outside work 

- 5 days of annual leave: Take time to rest and recharge during your 12-week internship 

- Life in the office: Get to know your colleagues in spaces designed for collaboration, with free food, a great selection of ice cream and an on-site barista 

- Learning and development: Build your skills and explore your interests with access to O’Reilly, our online learning platform 

We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work. 

We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you. 

Sponsorship

Applicants must already have the right to work in the UK for the full duration of the programme, without requiring visa sponsorship. We are unable to sponsor work visas for our Early Careers opportunities.

Introduction to Graphcore

At Graphcore, we’re building next generation AI compute: From semiconductors and software to systems at datacenter scale. We are proud to be owned by SoftBank Group and work with other companies in the SoftBank family to deliver AI compute to customers working at the AI frontier.
Starting your career here means working alongside people with different backgrounds and expertise, from AI researchers to chip designers and software engineers. You’ll learn from each other, bring fresh ideas and help solve challenging problems together.

How to apply and what to expect 

To apply, answer the application questions below and upload your CV and cover letter. We’ll let you know the outcome of your application by early December at the latest. If successful, you’ll be invited to complete a technical assessment. Candidates who reach the final stage will then be invited to attend in-person assessments in early spring.

Curious about where your skills could take you? Apply for a summer internship at Graphcore and help us build what comes next.

postings.title: Power Integrity Engineer
postings.description:
About the job

Shape the power delivery that will make Graphcore’s next-generation AI compute systems reliable.

As a Power Integrity Engineer, you will analyse power-delivery networks across silicon, package and PCB, turning complex behaviour into practical design recommendations.

You will build PDN models, investigate parasitics, and use frequency-domain and time-domain analysis to understand stability, droop, resonances and transient response. Your work will directly inform decoupling, layout, and power and ground distribution choices.

You will use electromagnetic simulation to understand resistance, inductance, coupling and impedance. You will also validate assumptions, identify technical risks, and connect simulation results with hardware measurements.

You will start with clearly scoped PI problems, supported by experienced engineers when wider decisions are involved. As your capability grows, you will own larger parts of the PDN.

The team and culture

You will work alongside experienced PI engineers and colleagues across hardware disciplines, connecting analysis with real design decisions and measurements.

You will own defined technical problems and move quickly from modelling to recommendations. Decisions are grounded in evidence, physical understanding and clear communication of uncertainty.

You will contribute to design reviews, speak up when results expose risk, and take responsibility for the quality of your analysis.

What we’re looking for

- Build, integrate and analyse PDN models for defined power rails, package structures, PCB designs or subsystems.

- Use frequency-domain impedance analysis and time-domain simulation to investigate voltage stability, droop, resonances and transient response.

- Evaluate decoupling choices and placement, considering capacitance, parasitics and the interaction between silicon, package and PCB.

- Use electromagnetic simulation to extract and understand resistance, inductance, coupling and impedance in power and ground structures.

- Check model setup, assumptions, convergence and physical validity, and explain the limitations of your results.

- Translate findings into practical recommendations for decoupling, layout, power and ground distribution, and other PI design choices.

- Document results, identify technical risks and contribute to design reviews and PI verification.

- Work with test engineers to define relevant measurements, interpret results and investigate differences between simulation and hardware.

- Collaborate with PI, SI

The Team and Culture

The Product Test and Diagnosis team detects, diagnoses and manages hardware defects across chips, boards and full systems. The team works close to design, manufacturing, silicon, software and systems engineering.

Decisions are shaped by evidence, design intent and manufacturing reality. You will help the team think big, challenge assumptions and raise engineering standards across disciplines.

· Deep expertise in manufacturing test for advanced, high-complexity Circuit Board Assemblies.

postings.title: Principal System Tests & Diagnostics Engineer
postings.description:
About us

Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute.

It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.

As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.

Responsibilities and Duties

We are seeking a highly skilled Principal System Tests & Diagnostics Engineer to develop, extend, and integrate specialized silicon validation and diagnostics tools for next-generation AI SoCs.

Unlike traditional validation roles focused on executing test plans, this position is responsible for developing the diagnostic software and stress tools that expose hardware failures, characterize silicon behavior, and improve platform observability throughout bring-up and validation.

You will work closely with Arm engineers to understand and extend existing diagnostics technologies while developing Graphcore-specific capabilities for future AI hardware.

Role Summary

You will work with existing Arm-developed diagnostics technologies and extend them to support Graphcore's next-generation AI silicon.

You will be responsible for developing system-level diagnostics and stress tools that integrate with an existing framework to detect data integrity, computational correctness, performance, and reliability issues across CPUs, AI accelerators, memory, storage, PCIe, firmware, BMC, and other platform components. Examples include silent data corruption (SDC) tests, power transient stress tools, and platform diagnostics, with opportunities to develop new diagnostics as future hardware capabilities evolve.

This role requires close collaboration with hardware architects, firmware engineers, validation engineers, and diagnostics teams to understand new hardware capabilities and translate them into reusable diagnostic software.

Responsibilities

- Learn and extend existing Arm diagnostics tools to support Graphcore’s AI platform.

- Develop specialized diagnostics and stress-testing software for CPU, memory, interconnect, PCIe, and other system components.

- Build reusable validation utilities that integrate into the existing validation framework.

- Develop tools that expose intermittent hardware failures including silent data corruption, timing-related issues, and hardware instability.

- Design configurable diagnostic applications supporting multiple silicon revisions, platforms, and execution environments.

- Develop automation for executing diagnostics across server and rack-scale validation environments.

- Design configuration-driven diagnostics supporting scalable parameterization and workload variation.

- Collaborate with hardware architects to understand new hardware capabilities and identify missing diagnostics.

- Work closely with firmware and validation teams to improve hardware observability.

- Debug low-level hardware, firmware, operating system, and driver interactions.

- Analyze diagnostic output and improve fault isolation methodologies.

- Develop software that enables engineers to reproduce and investigate difficult hardware failures.

- Contribute reusable libraries and utilities that improve engineering productivity across multiple validation teams.

Candidate Profile

Essential

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

- Strong experience developing hardware diagnostics, system validation software, firmware validation tools, or low-level systems software.

- Strong software development skills in Python and C/C++.

- Strong Linux systems experience.

- Strong understanding of modern server platform architecture, including how CPU, memory, PCIe, storage, networking, firmware, operating system, and device drivers interact within a complete system.

- Experience debugging hardware/software interactions across multiple layers of the platform.

- Experience developing diagnostics, stress testing, or hardware validation software.

- Experience with server platforms, embedded systems, or SoC validation.

- Strong analytical and debugging skills.

- Experience collaborating across hardware, firmware, software, and validation teams.

- Excellent communication and problem-solving skills.

Desirable:

- 

Preferred Qualifications

- Arm-based server platforms

- AI accelerators or high-performance computing systems

- Silent Data Corruption (SDC) testing

- Hardware stress testing

- Power transient analysis

- Hardware fault injection methodologies

- Firmware validation

- Silicon bring-up

- Performance characterization

- Hardware telemetry and observability

- BMC firmware or server management

- RAS (Reliability, Availability, Serviceability) technologies

- Validate across subsystems:

- CPU scaling and cache behavior

- Memory (DDR/HBM) bandwidth, latency, and NUMA effects

- Interconnect contention under multi-core load

- PCIe/I-O throughput, latency, and multi-device scenarios

- High-speed I/O validation

What Success Looks Like

Successful candidates will:

- Extend existing diagnostics technologies to support new Graphcore hardware.

Job Summary

Reporting to the Memory Validation leadership team, the Senior Silicon DDR/HBM Validation Engineer will be responsible for the bring-up, validation, characterization and debug of advanced memory subsystems used in next-generation AI compute platforms.

The role will focus on DDR and HBM technologies, working closely with silicon design, firmware, characterization, platform and systems teams to ensure robust memory subsystem functionality, performance and reliability. The successful candidate will take ownership of significant validation activities, contribute to debug and root-cause analysis efforts, and help improve validation methodologies, automation and infrastructure.

The Team

The Memory Validation team sits within the Validation organisation and is responsible for the bring-up, validation, characterization and debug of memory subsystems across Graphcore silicon and platform products.

The team supports DDR and HBM validation activities throughout the product lifecycle, from first silicon through production readiness. Engineers work closely with architecture, RTL, firmware, characterization, systems and platform teams to ensure memory technologies meet functionality, performance, reliability and performance objectives.

Responsibilities and Duties

- Execute validation and bring-up activities for DDR and HBM memory subsystems 

- Verify memory bring-up software, firmware and scripts against defined project requirements 

- Debug firmware, hardware and system-level issues and contribute to root-cause analysis activities 

- Analyse system logs, validation data and characterization results to identify failures and performance issues 

- Perform PHY characterization and analog-level analysis during stress testing and validation activities 

- Develop and execute functional, stress, performance and corner-case validation tests 

- Perform signal integrity, voltage, frequency and timing measurements using laboratory instrumentation 

- Characterize memory bandwidth, latency, training behaviour and subsystem stability across operating conditions 

- Develop Python-based automation, test infrastructure and reporting tools to improve validation efficiency 

- Collaborate with architecture, RTL, firmware and platform teams to investigate and resolve technical issues 

- Contribute to memory subsystem debug activities spanning silicon, firmware, board and system domains 

- Support development of validation methodologies, debug procedures and reporting frameworks 

- Contribute to continuous improvement of validation infrastructure and engineering processes 

- Support silicon characterization, production readiness and qualification activities 

- Document validation results and communicate findings to the wider engineering team 

Candidate Profile

Essential

- Strong experience validating DDR, LPDDR, HBM or related DRAM technologies 

- Deep understanding of DRAM architecture, memory subsystem operation and memory controller functionality 

- Experience with firmware, BIOS and Embedded C development 

- Strong programming skills in C and Python 

- Hands-on experience using laboratory equipment including oscilloscopes and related measurement instrumentation 

- Experience interfacing with low-speed peripherals including GPIO, SPI, I2C and UART/serial interfaces 

- Experience performing functional testing and signal measurements including voltage, frequency and timing analysis 

- Strong knowledge of embedded systems and microcontroller-based platforms 

- Hands-on experience with board bring-up and hardware validation activities 

- Experience debugging complex hardware, firmware and system-level issues 

- Experience performing silicon characterization and analysing validation results 

- Strong analytical, diagnostic and problem-solving skills 

- Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary teams 

Desirable

- Experience with memory IP bring-up environments, firmware or validation software 

- Experience with DDR or HBM PHY behaviour, memory controller architectures, training algorithms and calibration flows 

- Knowledge of memory subsystem performance analysis and workload characterization 

- Experience with memory margining, stress testing and reliability validation 

- Familiarity with JTAG, trace infrastructure and low-level debug tools 

- Experience with high-performance compute, AI accelerator or data center systems 

- Understanding of signal integrity and power integrity considerations in high-speed memory systems 

- Experience developing validation automation frameworks and regression environments 

- Experience supporting first-silicon bring-up and production readiness activities
