postings.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer (Large Systems)
postings.description:
Location: Bristol, London or Cambridge, UK 

About the job 

Help scale state-of-the art AI models across thousands of accelerators. 

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer in the Applied AI team, you will contribute to advancing AI technology by developing and optimising new and existing AI models for our specialised hardware. You will work on large scale systems where performance is critical to the success of our projects. 

Having visibility of the entire pipeline from novel accelerator hardware to state-of-the-art AI applications, and the software stack in-between, you will play a critical role in identifying opportunities to innovate and differentiate Graphcore’s technology. 

Furthermore, you’ll work closely with researchers in a rapidly-evolving field, where even the most senior engineers are constantly learning and adapting to exciting new challenges. 

We seek engineers with strong technical foundations who are curious and eager to understand and advance AI model implementation, at scale. 

We currently have multiple opportunities available in the team at Senior, Staff and Principal level and offer flexibility through a hybrid working model, from any of our UK offices. 

If you're excited about advancing the next generation of AI models on cutting-edge hardware, we’d love to hear from you! 

The team and culture 

The Applied AI team’s role is to be proxies for our customers, we need to understand the latest AI models, applications, and software, as well as our own hardware and software stack, to ensure that Graphcore’s technology works seamlessly with the AI ecosystem and at scale. 

Our work spans from low-level kernel development and optimisation for novel hardware through to implementing and scaling research-level algorithms for the latest AI models. 

We collaborate with the Research team to develop and publish novel ideas in domains such as efficient compute, model scaling and distributed training and inference of AI models for multiple modalities and applications. 

Responsibilities 

- Implement and train state-of-the-art machine learning models and optimise for performance, accuracy and scalability across systems comprising 1000s of accelerators. 

- Benchmark and profile ML models to identify performance bottlenecks. 

- Develop deep understanding across the software stack in order to optimise kernel implementations. 

- Test and evaluate new internal software releases, provide feedback to software engineering teams, make necessary code fixes, and conduct code reviews. 

- Design and conduct experiments on novel AI methods and evaluate results. 

- Collaborate with Research, Software, and Product teams to define, build, and test Graphcore’s next generation of AI hardware.

- Engage with AI community and keep in touch with the latest developments in AI.

What we’re looking for 

Essential: 

- Bachelor/Master's/PhD or equivalent experience in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Maths, Data Science, or related field. 

- Proficiency in deep learning frameworks like PyTorch/JAX. 

- Strong Python or C++ software development skills. 

- Expertise in hardware-accelerated deep learning from model training to optimisation and evaluation. 

- Capable of designing, executing and reporting from ML experiments. 

- Well-developed understanding of performance bottlenecks and how to overcome them. 

- Ability to move quickly in a fast-moving field. 

- Enjoy cross-functional work collaborating with other teams. 

- Strong communicator - able to explain complex technical concepts to different audiences. 

Desirable: 

- Experience in one or more of: 

- MLOps for Kubernetes-based clusters 

- Building production systems with large language models 

- Efficient computing based on low-precision arithmetic. 

- Experience writing C++/Triton/CUDA kernels for performance optimisation of ML models. 

- Experience in distributed training or inference of ML models across 64+ accelerators. 

- Familiarity with HPC systems and networking including Infiniband, NVLink, RoCE technologies, and cloud computing platforms. 

- Have contributed to open-source projects or published research papers in relevant fields. 

- Keen to present, publish and deliver talks in the AI community. 

Benefits 

- Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility 

- Generous leave: Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work 

- Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension 

- Phantom equity: Share in Graphcore’s success 

- Workplace experience: Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and drinks to support your day 

- Peace of mind protection: Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones 

- Electric Vehicle Scheme: Choose an electric vehicle and lease it through salary sacrifice 

- Flexible benefits: Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance and dental cover 

- Optional benefits: Dental cover, health cash plan, private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme, give as you earn 

We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work. 

We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.

postings.title: Senior Manufacturing Product Engineer
postings.description:
About the job

Own the manufacturing performance behind advanced AI compute systems in volume production.

As, Senior Manufacturing Product Engineer you will connect product design, test, quality and supply chain with manufacturing execution. You will support volume production across PCB assembly with our build partners in Taiwan.

Your work will improve yield, quality and manufacturability across complex products. You will link manufacturing process performance to the product metrics that matter most.

You will manage partner engineering relationships, resolve manufacturing issues and drive continuous improvement. You will also shape DfM feedback, production data requirements and next generation manufacturing technologies.

This role suits someone who combines practical manufacturing judgement with strong data thinking. You will work close to suppliers, product teams and the decisions that shape production outcomes.

Success in this role requires not only strong technical depth, but also the ability to work closely with multiple teams to ensure the simulator reflects reality and drives meaningful decisions.

The Team 

The Tenjin team focuses on building advanced simulation capabilities to model and predict the behaviour of large-scale ML workloads on next-generation hardware and software platforms.

We operate at the intersection of machine learning, systems, and architecture, developing tools that enable data-driven decisions long before systems are fully built or deployed. Our work helps shape both hardware and software direction by providing early insights into performance, scalability, and efficiency.

The team brings together engineers with backgrounds in simulation, ML systems, and computer architecture. We collaborate closely with ML engineers, performance teams, and silicon architects, but operate as an independent group focused on simulation as a core capability.

Responsibilities and Duties

- Design and evolve an ML application-level simulator that models workload execution, system behaviour, and resource usage

- Translate real-world workloads and benchmarking data into accurate simulation models

- Validate simulator outputs against real system measurements and continuously improve fidelity

- Build scalable, maintainable components that support evolving hardware and software capabilities

- Work closely with performance engineers, ML teams, and silicon architects to ensure the simulator reflects real use cases

- Drive adoption of the simulator as a decision-making tool across the organisation

Candidate Profile 

Essential:

- Strong C++ development experience, especially in performance-sensitive or large-scale systems

- Strong Python skills and familiarity with ML frameworks (e.g. PyTorch) and execution graphs

- Solid understanding of computer architecture, memory hierarchy, and heterogeneous systems

- Familiarity with ML accelerator concepts (e.g. tensor cores, compute tiles, high-bandwidth memory)

Desirable

- Understanding of modern ML architectures (e.g. transformers, MoE) in training and inference

- Experience with simulators or performance models (hardware or distributed systems)

- Knowledge of parallelism models and their mapping to hardware

- Experience with profiling and debugging complex, multi-layer systems

Benefits

In addition to a competitive salary, Graphcore offers annual leave policy, medical and dental health plans, a gym card, and employee pension (matched up to 4%). We review our benefits on a yearly basis to ensure we offer a valuable and rewarding benefits programme to our employees. We welcome people of different backgrounds and experiences; we’re committed to building an inclusive work environment that makes Graphcore a great home for everyone. We offer an equal opportunity process and understand that there are visible and invisible differences in all of us. As a Staff System Software Engineer, you will shape how Graphcore validates complex device drivers and platform tools. You will bring technical depth across Linux kernels, drivers and systems software.

Your work will help raise the quality bar for products that support the next generation of AI compute. You will influence design decisions, guide test infrastructure and drive reliability across the stack.

postings.description:

Join our dynamic Software Infrastructure team and take a pivotal role in scaling and managing our infrastructure. You will develop essential tools and services that empower our broader software team. - Develop tooling to support the build and release process

- Work closely with QA and the ML Software Stack to resolve any Integration issues, and providing fixes where necessary 

 Essential Skills 

- Familiarity with C++ toolchains, library packaging, CMake 

- Experience with Dependency management for C++ and Python projects 

- Experience with Python (Developing tooling / Packaging / Dependency management) 

- Debugging / Troubleshooting in Linux environments 

- Good communication skills 

 Desirable Skills: 

- Experience with Remote Execution (e.g. Bazel, Buildbarn) 

- Experience contributing towards Open Source projects 

- Experience with Buildstream (or similar Software Integration tooling)

In addition to a competitive salary, Graphcore offers flexible working, a generous annual leave policy, private medical insurance and health cash plan, a dental plan, pension (matched up to 5%), life assurance and income protection. Build the software that validates Graphcore’s machine learning stack, from frameworks to AI accelerator hardware.

You’ll design production-quality test infrastructure that engineers can extend, maintain and rely on as Graphcore’s ML software grows. Your work will help teams deliver reliable products, with clear evidence of numerical accuracy and performance across the stack. You’ll architect scalable test frameworks and build CI/CD pipelines that run across simulators, emulators and physical hardware. You’ll create representative ML workloads, analyse their execution and turn the results into practical improvements to testing and tooling.

This role gives you scope to shape software architecture and developer experience, not just add tests to existing systems. You’ll deepen your understanding of the AI compute stack while solving engineering problems that connect software design with hardware behaviour.

Graphcore’s ML QA engineers build automation, work with industry-standard frameworks and models, and contribute to upstream open-source projects. You’ll work across software teams, using code and design reviews to strengthen quality, security and maintainability.

You’ll use workload results to challenge assumptions and guide technical decisions about how Graphcore tests its ML stack. You’ll own improvements, act quickly on testing gaps and mentor junior engineers to raise the team’s technical standards.

What we’re looking for

- Strong Python skills, demonstrated through designing, developing and maintaining production-quality software.

- Software design and architecture skills for large, complex codebases, with a focus on testability and long-term maintainability.

- Experience building CI/CD pipelines and automated testing systems in Linux environments.

- Familiarity with C or C++, including the ability to read, debug and reason about low-level code.

postings.title: Senior Supply Chain Manager
postings.description:
About Graphcore

Graphcore is a global leader in artificial intelligence computing systems. We design advanced semiconductors and data center hardware that deliver the specialized processing power needed to advance AI while improving the efficiency required for broad adoption.

As part of SoftBank Group, Graphcore belongs to a family of companies developing some of the world's most transformative technologies. Our U.S. operations play an important role in building the future of AI computing.

The Opportunity

As Supply Chain Manager, you will lead end-to-end supply chain execution, supplier delivery performance, and program operations for critical networking, interconnect, and hardware platforms. You will align demand, material readiness, build plans, factory capacity, and delivery commitments with manufacturing ramp schedules across Graphcore's global operations.

This role combines hands-on execution with strong operational and financial judgment. You will partner with Engineering, Product, Manufacturing, Quality, Finance, Procurement, and external suppliers and integrators to manage complex dependencies, support new product introduction (NPI), and scale reliable supply chain processes.

What You'll Do

- Lead day-to-day operational engagement and performance management with global component suppliers, contract manufacturers, and rack-level system integrators.

- Manage supplier allocation, material availability, factory readiness, line capacity, build schedules, and final system delivery commitments for laboratory testing, validation, and deployment ramps.

- Aggregate demand signals across Engineering, Product, Manufacturing, and other internal teams to create aligned forecasts, build plans, and target commitments for suppliers and integration sites.

- Drive supply chain readiness and factory ramp execution through NPI milestones, including engineering validation testing (EVT), design validation testing (DVT), and production validation testing (PVT).

- Monitor component and system-level constraints, lead times, shortages, and delivery risks; establish recovery actions, escalation paths, and clear owners to protect program milestones.

- Establish standardized workflows for purchase order placement, open-order tracking, inventory reconciliation, and excess and obsolete (E&O) inventory management using centralized systems and clear buyer ownership.

- Build and maintain operational plans, supplier scorecards, dashboards, budgets, and forecasts that provide clear visibility into delivery, capacity, inventory, cost, and risk.

- Partner with suppliers and internal stakeholders to improve lead times, schedule performance, fulfillment, data accuracy, and overall supply chain efficiency.

- Translate complex operating metrics, financial performance, tradeoffs, and risk assessments into concise executive updates and timely senior-level escalations.

What You'll Bring

- 7 or more years of relevant experience in supply chain management, supplier operations, procurement, manufacturing operations, or a related field supporting complex hardware products.

- Experience in one or more relevant environments, such as AI infrastructure, data center systems, enterprise hardware, networking, high-performance computing, semiconductors, or similarly complex electronics.

- Direct experience managing contract manufacturers, system integrators, hardware component suppliers, or comparable manufacturing partners.

- Working knowledge of component forecasting and delivery for networking, interconnect, or related hardware, such as network interface cards, switches, cables, connectors, optics, or custom components.

- A demonstrated record of improving delivery schedules and lead times while managing supplier dependencies, material constraints, and operational risks.

- Experience managing substantial budgets, inventory, delivery commitments, supplier performance, and execution across multiple programs or sites.

- Strong analytical and financial acumen, with the ability to translate demand, supply, inventory, cost, and capacity data into clear operating decisions.

- Ability to lead through influence, navigate ambiguity, solve complex operational problems, and align Engineering, Product, Manufacturing, Quality, Finance, and Procurement stakeholders.

- Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present metrics, risks, recovery plans, and recommendations to executive audiences.

- A bachelor's degree in supply chain management, business, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with rack-level system integration and full-system fulfillment.

- Experience supporting product introductions and manufacturing ramps for advanced computing, networking, or data center hardware.

- Experience with enterprise resource planning, purchasing, order-management, inventory, or supplier-performance systems.

- A master's degree or MBA.

These qualifications are helpful, not mandatory. We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet every preferred qualification.

U.S. Benefits Overview

Graphcore offers competitive compensation and a benefits package designed to support employees' health, financial well-being, families, flexibility, and development. Benefits for eligible U.S. employees may include:

- Medical, dental, and vision coverage, together with mental health and well-being support.

- A 401(k) retirement plan with company matching, plus company-provided life and disability coverage.

- Flexible paid time off, paid company holidays, flexible working hours, and parental leave.

- Learning and career development support, including development plans, training allowances, and online learning resources.

- Office amenities and team-led social, community, and well-being activities.

Benefits vary by work location, employment status, and plan eligibility and are subject to the terms of the applicable plans and company policies. This overview is not a contract or guarantee of benefits.

Equal Opportunity and Accommodations

Graphcore is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law.

Graphcore is committed to an inclusive and accessible hiring process. If you need a reasonable accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, please let the recruiting team know.

Candidate Privacy

Personal information submitted during the recruiting process will be handled in accordance with Graphcore's applicable candidate privacy notices.

postings.description:
About us

Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.

As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.

Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore enjoys a culture of continuous learning and constant innovation.

Job Summary

We are seeking a Senior Systems or Staff Hardware Engineer to provide advanced operational, diagnostic, and engineering support for Graphcore’s Arm-based hardware platforms across lab and data center environments.

This role focuses on supporting hardware bring-up, validation, and troubleshooting of complex AI compute platforms, including server blades, racks, and rack-scale infrastructure. The successful candidate will collaborate closely with engineering, platform, and data center teams to ensure the reliability and performance of next-generation AI systems.

The Team

The Systems Engineering and Hardware Engineering teams are responsible for enabling the bring-up, validation, and operational reliability of Graphcore’s AI infrastructure platforms.

The team works closely with server engineering, firmware teams, platform architects, and data center operations to support the development, testing, and deployment of next-generation AI compute systems.

This collaborative environment enables rapid problem-solving and continuous improvement of Graphcore’s hardware platforms from early development through production deployment.

Responsibilities and Duties

- Lead advanced break-fix troubleshooting for server blades, motherboards, power systems, and rack-scale infrastructure.

- Support engineering bring-up activities, including component validation and firmware interaction testing.

- Diagnose system-level failures involving thermal behavior, power anomalies, network configuration, and BIOS/BMC issues.

- Collaborate with server engineering teams to perform root cause analysis and propose corrective actions or design improvements.

- Support deployment and rollout of next-generation hardware platforms through structured validation and qualification cycles.

- Interface with facilities and infrastructure teams to understand environmental factors impacting system reliability.

- Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs), troubleshooting guides, and validation documentation.

- Provide guidance and mentorship to junior technicians and engineers on troubleshooting methodologies and hardware diagnostics.

- Participate in on-call rotations or off-hours support during critical engineering milestones or hardware bring-up phases.

Candidate Profile

Essential

- Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related discipline.

- 7+ years experience with server hardware architectures and board-level debugging.

- Experience analyzing system logs, hardware telemetry, and power/thermal metrics to isolate hardware failures.

- Hands-on experience with HPC systems, AI compute platforms, or rack-scale infrastructure.

- Strong collaboration skills and ability to work effectively in fast-paced engineering environments.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Desirable

- Experience supporting prototype or pre-production hardware bring-up.

- Familiarity with data center facilities, including liquid cooling and power distribution systems.

- Experience using Python, Bash, or automation tools for hardware validation or troubleshooting.

- Exposure to structured failure analysis and reliability engineering methodologies.

USA Benefits

In addition to a competitive salary, Graphcore offers flexible working and a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, wellbeing and financial future. Our benefits include medical, dental and vision coverage, Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs), Health Savings Accounts (HSAs), disability and life insurance, a 401(k) retirement plan, commuter benefits, wellness services and an Employee Assistance Programme (EAP). We welcome people of different backgrounds and experiences; we're committed to building an inclusive work environment that makes Graphcore a great home for everyone. We offer an equal opportunity process and understand that there are visible and invisible differences in all of us. We can provide a flexible approach to interview and encourage you to chat to us if you require any reasonable adjustments.

postings.description:
Salary Range: (Determined during interview process, based on technical fit for each level of role)

Staff Engineer - PLN 350,700 - 474,400 + Benefits + Equity

Senior Engineer - PLN 260,400 - 352,200 + Benefits + Equity

Subject to alignment to the responsibilities and duties of the role.

Location: Gdańsk - Hybrid Working Policy - 3 Days per week in office

About the job

Explore how a next-generation AI architecture behaves from rack scale to data centre scale. 

As a Senior Systems Engineer, you will investigate a novel AI computing architecture under demanding real-world workloads. You will work on problems where answers aren't readily known, turning curiosity into measurable evidence.

You will design experiments, benchmark representative AI workloads and explore how hardware components and software interact at scale. When behaviour is unexpected, you will turn this into new measurements.

Your work will help infrastructure engineers, architects and application specialists understand system behaviour, performance, scalability and reliability across the stack. You will also help develop tooling and automation to collect, analyse and visualise system metrics.

You do not need to be an AI expert. You will need strong judgement, curiosity and a clear preference for evidence over opinion. You will love this role if you are someone who takes initiative, questions assumptions and enjoys working in areas where the answers are not yet known.

The team and culture

The System QA team is distributed across multiple locations. We work hard to stay connected and collaborate closely. Our daily team meetings feel more like a virtual coffee break than a formal status update with space to share ideas, ask questions, discuss discoveries and solve problems together.

We value trust, autonomy and openness, and we understand that great engineers don't all follow the same career path. What matters is the quality of your work, your curiosity, and your willingness to explore challenging problems.

You will have regular 1:1s with your people manager where you will have the opportunity to discuss things that matter to you. You will have dedicated time each week to focus on your CPD. The technical lead will provide direction and help set priorities, but everyone in the team is there to support each other.

One of our core principles is that we measure and report what we observe without trying to make results look better or worse than they are.

What we're looking for

- Comfortable using Python to write tests, automate tasks, analyse data or develop practical engineering tools.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- A curiosity-driven approach to investigating complex systems.

- Ability to explain technical findings clearly, using accurate and reproducible evidence.

- Confidence to work independently, take responsibility and collaborate across engineering teams.

- Experience in some of the following would be valuable: AI workloads and benchmarking, systems architecture, parallel and distributed computing, automation, containers or modern orchestration infrastructure

While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences from different industries. We actively welcome applications from engineers to the profession through a returnship or after a career break.

Benefits

- Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility

- Generous leave: Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work

- Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension

- Phantom equity: Share in Graphcore’s success

- Workplace experience: Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day

- Peace of mind protection: Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones

- Flexible benefits: Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance and dental cover

- Optional benefits: Dental cover, health cash plan, private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme, give as you earn

We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.

Sponsorship

Applicants must have the legal right to work in the Poland. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa applications for this role.

As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.

You will be responsible for developing system-level diagnostics and stress tools that integrate with an existing framework to detect data integrity, computational correctness, performance, and reliability issues across CPUs, AI accelerators, memory, storage, PCIe, firmware, BMC, and other platform components. Examples include silent data corruption (SDC) tests, power transient stress tools, and platform diagnostics, with opportunities to develop new diagnostics as future hardware capabilities evolve.

This role requires close collaboration with hardware architects, firmware engineers, validation engineers, and diagnostics teams to understand new hardware capabilities and translate them into reusable diagnostic software.

Responsibilities

- Learn and extend existing Arm diagnostics tools to support Graphcore’s AI platform.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills for technical reporting and cross-functional collaboration.

Peripheral Component Interconnect Express (PCIe) generations 4/5/6, Ethernet, Double Data Rate (DDR) memory, serializer/deserializer (SerDes) links, Serial Peripheral Interface (SPI), and Inter-Integrated Circuit (I²C).

postings.title: Silicon Summer Intern 2027
postings.description:
Duration: 12 weeks 
Salary: £2500 per month 
Start date: June 2027 
Application deadline: Midnight 29th November 
We encourage you to apply early, as we may close applications before the advertised deadline. 

The Internship Programme at Graphcore 

Explore a career at Graphcore through a 12-week summer internship, gaining hands-on experience on real projects. You’ll bring fresh ideas, put your learning into practice and help shape what we’re creating. Along the way, you’ll tackle challenging problems with a team who welcome your questions and support you as you build your skills and confidence. 

What you’ll work on

Bring your curiosity, bright ideas and problem-solving skills to the chips behind tomorrow’s AI systems.

As a Silicon summer intern, you’ll join one of our four specialist Silicon teams: logical design, verification, physical design or design for test (DFT). You’ll contribute to real chip development, learning from experienced colleagues and building your understanding of how advanced AI chips are designed, verified and prepared for manufacture.

Depending on your team, you’ll work on areas such as register-transfer level (RTL) design, SOC integration, verification methods, physical implementation or the critical role of DFT. You’ll use industry-standard electronic design automation (EDA) tools and take ownership of clear tasks, with support from experienced engineers.

How you’ll learn and grow

During the 12-week programme, you’ll develop practical silicon engineering skills in the team you join, building on the fundamentals you’ve learned through your studies and projects.

Hands-on tasks will help you learn modern design techniques and use industry-standard EDA tools. You’ll build skills in areas such as RTL, verification, timing or physical design, depending on your team’s focus.

Feedback from reviews and practical problem solving will help you develop your technical judgement, explain your approach and understand how your work fits into the wider chip development process. Bring your curiosity and willingness to learn; we’ll support you as you build your knowledge and confidence.

What we're looking for

- Working towards a degree in Electronic Engineering, Computer Science, or a related subject such as Physics or Maths. 

- Technical skills in C, C++ or Python, demonstrated through study, projects, hobbies or practical experience 

- An interest in AI compute and silicon design, including ASICs, verification, logical design, DFT or physical design, with motivation to learn EDA tools and modern design techniques 

- A curious, self-starting approach, with examples from activities or hobbies beyond your studies, plus clear communication and the ability to work well with others 

You don’t need an engineering background to join us. If you’re curious, motivated and enjoy solving problems, we’ll teach you the skills you need.

Previous industry experience is not required. Tell us what you built or investigated through coursework, personal or team projects, hobbies or other relevant experience, how you approached it and what you learned. 

Benefits 

- Flexible working: Find a balance between your internship and life outside work 

- 5 days of annual leave: Take time to rest and recharge during your 12-week internship 

- Life in the office: Get to know your colleagues in spaces designed for collaboration, with free food, a great selection of ice cream and an on-site barista 

- Learning and development: Build your skills and explore your interests with access to O’Reilly, our online learning platform 

We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work. 

We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you. 

Sponsorship 

Applicants must already have the right to work in the UK for the full duration of the programme, without requiring visa sponsorship. We are unable to sponsor work visas for our Early Careers opportunities.

Introduction to Graphcore 

At Graphcore, we’re building next generation AI compute: From semiconductors and software to systems at datacentre scale. We are proud to be owned by SoftBank Group and work with other companies in the SoftBank family to deliver AI compute to customers working at the AI frontier. 

An internship at Graphcore gives you the chance to explore where your interests and skills could take you. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds and expertise, from AI researchers to chip designers and software engineers. Together, you’ll share ideas and solve challenging problems, building experience and confidence to help you decide what comes next. 

How to apply and what to expect 

To apply, answer the application questions below and upload your CV and cover letter. We’ll let you know the outcome of your application by early December at the latest. If successful, you’ll be invited to complete a technical assessment. Candidates who reach the final stage will then be invited to attend in-person assessments in early spring. 

Curious about where your skills could take you? Apply for a summer internship at Graphcore and help us build what comes next.

About the job

Own verification that turns complex silicon architecture into reliable AI compute hardware.

As a Silicon Verification Engineer, you will help ensure Graphcore RTL matches the architecture specification. Your work will protect silicon quality before designs move into physical implementation.

You will sit where architecture, logical design and verification meet. You will directly influence how issues are found, understood and resolved before they become costly.

You will plan verification, define coverage, generate tests and diagnose failures. You will also improve shared infrastructure that helps engineers move faster and identify problems earlier.

The work is technically deep, with clear impact on our silicon. You will help build the discipline, pace and quality needed for ambitious AI compute programs at scale.

The team and culture

The verification team works closely with Architecture, Logical Design and Physical Design. Clear plans, coverage goals, test results and direct technical feedback shape the work.

You will take ownership, follow evidence and keep communication open across sites. The team values people who speak up early and make complex problems easier to solve.

Decisions are driven by technical reasoning, shared data and practical trade-offs. You will have room to lead through your expertise, not just your title.

What we're looking for

- Verification experience in CPU, ASIC or closely related silicon environments

- Experience with UVM, SVA, assembly, compilers, Git or DRMS tools

- Ability to plan verification work and drive functional coverage to closure

postings.title: Site Reliability Engineering Lead
postings.description:
About Graphcore

How often do you get the chance to build a technology that transforms the future of humanity?

Graphcore products have set the standard in made-for-AI compute hardware and software, gaining global attention and industry acclaim. Now we are developing the next generation of artificial intelligence compute with systems that will allow AI researchers to develop more advanced models, help scientists unlock exciting new discoveries, and power companies around the world as they put AI at the heart of their business.

Graphcore recently joined SoftBank Group – bringing large and ongoing investment from one of the world’s leading backers of innovative AI companies.

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Site Reliability Engineering leader to build and lead a new SRE organization responsible for the production operation of a rapidly scaling AI supercomputing platform. The environment combines highly customized compute, high-performance networking, storage and supporting infrastructure, and will grow through multiple phases of deployment.

This is a rare opportunity to establish the reliability function for a new platform from the ground up. The platform and its operational model are being developed in parallel and will ultimately support a 24x7x365 production service with stringent availability requirements.

You will take the SRE organization from initial formation through production launch, stabilization and scale. This includes hiring and developing the team, defining the operating model, establishing production readiness and incident-management practices, and ensuring reliability and operability are engineered into the platform from the outset.

SRE is responsible for the operational capability required to run the platform reliably in production, while partnering with engineering teams that remain accountable for the reliability and operability of the systems they build.

This is not a purely managerial position. During the development and early production phases, the SRE Manager will be expected to work directly with engineering teams, develop a deep understanding of the platform, and participate in troubleshooting and incident response.

Over time, success will increasingly mean building the people, processes, automation, tooling, and operational discipline that allow the organization to operate effectively without depending on you for day-to-day escalation.

Responsibilities and Duties

- Build the SRE Organization:

- Build and develop the team from its initial formation through full 24x7x365 production operations, including defining roles, interviewing and hiring team members, establishing career expectations, and developing future technical leaders.

- Mentor engineers and team leads, develop successors, and build an organization capable of operating effectively without depending on any single individual.

- Work with leadership to forecast staffing requirements as the platform grows from initial deployment through full production scale.

- Establish the Production Operating Model:

- Define the operating model for an SRE organization, including staffing and coverage model, escalation paths, on-call responsibilities, incident management, handoffs, production access, change management, and operational readiness requirements.

- Establish clear operational interfaces with Datacenter Operations, engineering teams, vendors, and other service owners.

- Establish and continuously improve production readiness standards, runbooks, operational procedures, failure-mode documentation, escalation processes, and incident response practices with a strong emphasis on automation and engineering over manual operational work.

- Develop training, cross-training, simulation, and production incident-response exercises to ensure the team can operate independently and confidently.

- Engineer Reliability Into the Platform:

- Embed with platform engineering teams during development to gain deep technical knowledge of the system and ensure reliability, serviceability, observability, and operational requirements are incorporated into the platform before production.

- Lead the development of SLOs, operational health indicators, alerting standards, incident severity definitions, and reliability reporting appropriate for a large-scale production infrastructure service.

- Build a culture in which recurring operational problems are engineered out through automation, improved observability, better platform design, and elimination of unnecessary toil.

- Ensure the SRE organization can rapidly diagnose and mitigate issues across compute, networking, storage, and supporting infrastructure.

- Develop strong technical depth within the team while maintaining access to specialist expertise in critical areas such as high-performance networking, storage, observability, and platform scheduling.

- Lead Production Operations:

- Lead or participate in major production incidents as necessary, particularly during platform development, launch, and early production.

- Establish a blameless post-incident review process focused on identifying systemic improvements and ensuring corrective actions are completed.

- Serve as the senior operational authority for the SRE organization and represent production reliability concerns in engineering and leadership discussions.

Required Skills and Experience

- Significant experience leading or building an SRE, Production Engineering, Infrastructure Reliability, or comparable function supporting large-scale, highly available production infrastructure.

- Experience taking a new or rapidly evolving platform through production readiness, launch, stabilization, and ongoing operation.

- Experience building and operating sustainable 24x7x365 production support or on-call organizations.

- Strong understanding of modern Site Reliability Engineering principles, including SLOs, incident management, observability, automation, toil reduction, capacity management, and production readiness.

- Strong incident leadership experience, including managing high-severity, multi-team production incidents under significant time pressure.

- A strong systems engineering background with a working understanding of Linux, networking, storage, distributed systems, automation, and production infrastructure.

- Ability to operate effectively at both the leadership and hands-on technical levels, moving comfortably between organizational design, architecture discussions, troubleshooting, and incident response.

- Demonstrated ability to lead, hire, mentor, develop, and retain a growing team of strong technical engineers at various levels of capability

- Strong judgment regarding when to solve an immediate operational problem and when to invest in eliminating the underlying failure mode.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, particularly during incidents and when communicating technical risk to senior leadership.

- Ability to manage conflicting priorities under a pressured environment

Desired but Not Required

Candidates are not expected to have experience in all the areas below. Experience in several would be particularly valuable:

- High-performance networking technologies such as InfiniBand, RDMA, RoCE, or large-scale Ethernet fabrics.

- Large-scale parallel or distributed storage systems.

- Workload schedulers and orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes, Slurm, or comparable systems.

- Production observability and service-level monitoring for complex distributed infrastructure.

- Custom or early-generation hardware, firmware, or environments where hardware and software are developed concurrently.

- Operational relationships and escalation processes involving datacenter operations and infrastructure/hardware/networking vendors.

- Rapid capacity expansion, datacenter migration, or transitions between temporary and permanent production environments.

What Success Looks Like

- The SRE organization is staffed, trained and capable of supporting the platform through production launch and subsequent growth.

- Production readiness, observability, incident management and operational engineering practices are embedded into how the platform is developed and operated.

- The team has the technical depth, automation and operating discipline to resolve most production issues independently, with leadership escalation reserved for genuinely exceptional events.

In addition to a competitive salary, Graphcore offers flexible working and a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, wellbeing and financial future. Our benefits include medical, dental and vision coverage, Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs), Health Savings Accounts (HSAs), disability and life insurance, a 401(k) retirement plan, commuter benefits, wellness services and an Employee Assistance Programme (EAP). We welcome people of different backgrounds and experiences; we're committed to building an inclusive work environment that makes Graphcore a great home for everyone. We offer an equal opportunity process and understand that there are visible and invisible differences in all of us. We can provide a flexible approach to interview and encourage you to chat to us if you require any reasonable adjustments.

postings.description:
About the job

Build the test strategy that protects Graphcore’s system software releases at scale.

As a Staff System Software Engineer, you will shape integration and system testing across firmware, BMC and Linux device drivers. Your work will help create a high quality gate for system software release packages.

You will design, build, automate and report tests across complex server class systems. You will also develop reusable tools, pipelines and packaging solutions that help teams move faster with confidence.

This role needs deep low level software knowledge and strong system thinking. You will own hard technical areas, guide best practice and stay close to the code.

The team and culture

You will join a new integration and system test team within System Software QA. The team verifies integrated components across BMC, firmware and Linux device drivers.

Work happens close to the hardware, across component teams and QA. You will partner with developers, consult package stakeholders and turn use cases into robust system tests.

Decisions are shaped by evidence, clear technical reasoning and ownership. You will be expected to speak up, act fast and raise standards through hands-on leadership.

What we’re looking for

· Strong experience in low level system testing and integration across complex software and hardware layers.
· Deep understanding of RTOS, complex boot logic, Linux and device drivers.
· Test development capability using Python and C/C++.
· Experience working with hardware, debuggers, CI/CD pipelines and build or integration tools.
· Ability to debug cross-layer issues and drive root-cause investigations to lasting corrective actions.
· Clear communication skills, with the ability to mentor engineers and document complex technical decisions.

While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences. If you meet most of our essential criteria, we encourage you to submit an application and showcase how your background makes you a strong candidate.

postings.description:
About Graphcore 

Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute.  

It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.  

As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.   

Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore enjoys a culture of continuous learning and constant innovation.

Job Summary

Join our dynamic Software Infrastructure team and take a pivotal role in scaling and managing our infrastructure. You will develop essential tools and services that empower our broader software team. Your contributions will enhance the build, test, deployment, and productisation processes of our Machine Learning Software components. Work with our High-Performance Computing (HPC) AI platforms and gain invaluable experience in distributed systems.

The Team

The Build Engineering team is a function within the Software Infrastructure team, which focuses on the overall process of building and integration of the Machine Learning Software Stack. You will work closely with the QA and development teams to get an understanding of how our ML SW stack is built, helping to ensure good build practices, and proving that the stack works together and is reproducible in secure, sandboxed environments. 

 Responsibilities & Duties 

- Developing and looking after our internal software integration system 

- Develop tooling to support the build and release process 

- Advise on best practices for the build, release, and distribution of Software 

- Work closely with QA and the ML Software Stack to resolve any Integration issues, and providing fixes where necessary 

 Essential Skills 

- Familiarity with C++ toolchains, library packaging, CMake 

- Experience with Dependency management for C++ and Python projects 

- Experience with Python (Developing tooling / Packaging / Dependency management) 

- Debugging / Troubleshooting in Linux environments 

- Good communication skills 

 Desirable Skills: 

- Experience with Remote Execution (e.g. Bazel, Buildbarn) 

- Experience contributing towards Open Source projects 

- Experience with Buildstream (or similar Software Integration tooling) 

Benefits

In addition to a competitive salary, Graphcore offers flexible working, a generous annual leave policy, private medical insurance and health cash plan, a dental plan, pension (matched up to 5%), life assurance and income protection. We have a generous parental leave policy and an employee assistance programme (which includes health, mental wellbeing, and bereavement support). Along the way, you’ll tackle challenging problems with a team who welcome your questions and support you as you build your skills and confidence. 

What you’ll work on 

Put your low-level programming skills to work on the drivers that connect Graphcore’s AI hardware with machine learning software. 

As a Software Engineering Intern in Drivers and Utilities, you’ll explore kernel and user-space development alongside engineers working across the hardware and software stack. Your contributions will help the wider software team use Graphcore hardware efficiently and support the systems our customers depend on. 

Your tasks could include writing code, adding unit tests and manually testing your own and teammates’ changes. You’ll also help maintain continuous integration (CI) and fix issues, contributing to the work that keeps software development moving. 

The team and culture 

The Drivers and Utilities team sits within System Software, alongside Firmware and System QA. You’ll work with engineers who collaborate directly with Poplar SDK developers, silicon engineers and hardware engineers. 

Technical design discussions, code reviews and Scrum sessions will help you understand how the team develops and coordinates its work. You can ask for help as you learn the codebase, discuss different approaches and use feedback to improve your changes. 

Decisions are shaped by design discussions, code reviews and test results. As an intern, you’ll be encouraged to ask questions, share ideas and flag problems early, with support from experienced engineers as you learn. 

How you’ll learn and grow 

Over the 12 weeks, you’ll build practical experience in low-level software development, testing and continuous integration through the work your tasks focus on. 

Following changes from an initial idea through implementation and testing will help you understand what makes driver software reliable. You’ll learn how to check your work, investigate issues and contribute to a shared codebase, gaining a clearer view of a career close to the hardware. 

Your internship is a chance to explore a future at Graphcore. Depending on your performance and the roles available, there may be an opportunity to join one of our graduate programmes once you’ve graduated. 

What we’re looking for 

- Currently studying for a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Maths, Machine Learning, Data Science or a related field 

- Low-level software experience, such as embedded code or device drivers, and introductory programming experience in C, C++ or Python. Personal or university projects count 

- Basic electronics knowledge, including the ability to read and understand schematics and datasheets 

- Awareness of continuous integration systems such as Jenkins, plus experience using Git to manage source code, raise and review pull requests, and merge branches 

Previous industry experience is not required. Tell us what you built or investigated through coursework, personal or team projects or other relevant experience, how you approached it and what you learned. 

Benefits 

- Flexible working: Find a balance between your internship and life outside work 

- 5 days of annual leave: Take time to rest and recharge during your 12-week internship 

- Life in the office: Get to know your colleagues in spaces designed for collaboration, with free food, a great selection of ice cream and an on-site barista 

- Learning and development: Build your skills and explore your interests with access to O’Reilly, our online learning platform 

We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work. 

We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you. 

Sponsorship 

Applicants must already have the right to work in the UK for the full duration of the programme, without requiring visa sponsorship. We are unable to sponsor work visas for our Early Careers opportunities. 

Introduction to Graphcore 

At Graphcore, we’re building next generation AI compute: From semiconductors and software to systems at datacenter scale. We are proud to be owned by SoftBank Group and work with other companies in the SoftBank family to deliver AI compute to customers working at the AI frontier. 

An internship at Graphcore gives you the chance to explore where your interests and skills could take you. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds and expertise, from AI researchers to chip designers and software engineers. Together, you’ll share ideas and solve challenging problems, building experience and confidence to help you decide what comes next. 

How to apply and what to expect 

To apply, answer the application questions below and upload your CV and cover letter. We’ll let you know the outcome of your application by early December at the latest. If successful, you’ll be invited to complete a technical assessment. Candidates who reach the final stage will then be invited to attend in-person assessments in early spring.

Curious about where your skills could take you? Apply for a summer internship at Graphcore and help us build what comes next.

Reporting into the Global Sourcing Management team, this role will partner closely with Engineering, Product, Operations, Manufacturing, and Supply Chain teams to develop sourcing strategies, manage supplier relationships, negotiate commercial agreements, and ensure resilient supply for critical infrastructure components.

The successful candidate will combine strong commercial acumen with a solid understanding of AI infrastructure technologies, enabling effective engagement with suppliers and technical stakeholders while balancing cost, quality, delivery, scalability, and risk objectives. This role draws upon leading practices from AI infrastructure sourcing environments while aligning with Graphcore’s strategic sourcing model.

The Team

The Global Sourcing Management (GSM) team defines and executes supplier strategies across Graphcore’s hardware and infrastructure ecosystem.

The team works closely with Engineering, Product Management, Operations, Manufacturing, and Supply Chain functions to establish strategic supplier partnerships that support technology development, infrastructure deployment, operational excellence, and long-term business growth. The team is responsible for ensuring Graphcore has access to the technologies, manufacturing capabilities, and supply capacity required to support current and future business needs.

Responsibilities and Duties

- Own sourcing strategy development and execution for assigned AI infrastructure commodities and suppliers.

- Lead end-to-end sourcing activities including supplier identification, qualification, RFQ/RFP management, commercial evaluation, supplier selection, and contract negotiation.

- Develop and maintain strong supplier relationships, driving performance across cost, quality, delivery, capacity, and responsiveness.

- Partner closely with Engineering and Product teams to understand technical requirements and align sourcing decisions with product and infrastructure objectives.

- Evaluate supplier capabilities, technology roadmaps, manufacturing readiness, and scalability to support business growth.

- Lead commercial negotiations for pricing, supply agreements, capacity reservations, development activities, and long-term strategic partnerships.

- Build and maintain cost models, benchmark analyses, and total cost of ownership assessments to support sourcing decisions.

- Drive supplier performance management through regular business reviews, scorecards, corrective action plans, and continuous improvement initiatives.

- Identify and mitigate supply chain risks through market intelligence, supplier diversification, contingency planning, and business continuity strategies.

- Monitor industry trends, supplier landscapes, component availability, and market dynamics to inform sourcing strategies and procurement decisions.

- Collaborate with Legal, Finance, Quality, Operations, and Manufacturing teams to ensure sourcing activities support business objectives and compliance requirements.

- Provide regular reporting and recommendations to leadership regarding supplier performance, commercial opportunities, sourcing risks, and mitigation plans.

Candidate Profile

Essential

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Business, or a related subject area.

- Experience in strategic sourcing, procurement, supplier management, or supply chain roles within technology, infrastructure, electronics, or hardware-focused environments.

- Knowledge of AI infrastructure, high-performance computing, servers, networking, storage technologies, or related hardware ecosystems.

- Demonstrated experience leading supplier negotiations, commercial agreements, and sourcing projects.

- Strong analytical and commercial skills, including cost modelling, pricing analysis, and total cost of ownership methodologies.

- Experience managing supplier performance and driving measurable improvements in cost, quality, delivery, and supply continuity.

- Ability to assess technical requirements and collaborate effectively with engineering and product development teams.

- Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

- Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills.

- Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel and PowerPoint.

Desirable

- Experience sourcing infrastructure hardware, compute platforms, servers, networking equipment, storage systems, PCBAs, or related technologies.

- Familiarity with global supplier ecosystems across North America, Europe, and Asia.

- Experience supporting data center, cloud infrastructure, AI infrastructure, or high-performance computing deployments.

- Understanding of manufacturing processes, supplier industrialization, and new product introduction activities.

- Experience developing supplier risk management, resiliency, and business continuity programmes.

- Knowledge of responsible sourcing and sustainability considerations within technology supply chains.
